epiphy.config.title: Epiphy Core Configuration
epiphy.config.subtitle: Stored under <gameDir>/config/epiphy-*.toml (outside world saves; changes apply immediately)
epiphy.config.client.enableSurface2D.too: Master switch for screen overlays, custom HUD panels, container sandwich layers, slot badges, and world 2D planes.
epiphy.config.client.enableNativeTextBat: Captures glyph quads once and groups per-character draws by font atlas RenderType in native Java bytecode, eliminating cross-atlas flush storms.
Controls outline tap count:
• High: 8-tap outer ring + 4-tap inner bridge
• Balanced: Standard 8-tap ring
• Performance: Lightweight 4-tap ring
• Off: Core glyph & shadow only
epiphy.config.client.enableFboCache.tool: Allows complex static declarative UI subtrees to reuse off-screen TextureTarget FBOs.
epiphy.config.client.enableGuiTextureRem: Enables zero-pollution per-screen texture redirection without mutating the global TextureManager.
epiphy.config.client.surface2DFrameBudge: Per-frame CPU budget (ms) before throttling low-priority danmaku; high-priority overlays and HUD/GUI panels are never throttled.
epiphy.config.client.enableItem3D.toolti: Master switch for declarative 3D shader overlays and procedural geometry layers bound to items.
epiphy.config.client.enableItem3DOverlay: Controls custom GLSL surface overlays flush with item base geometry.
epiphy.config.client.enableItem3DGeometr: Controls orbiting ribbon rings, helices, and orthogonal sprite clusters around bound items.
epiphy.config.client.item3DGuiScale.tool: Global scale multiplier for 3D item geometry layers inside hotbar and inventory slots.
epiphy.config.client.enableWorld3D.toolt: Controls client rendering of world-space 3D rings, beams, helices, and spheres.
Enables real-time 3D source tracking, distance attenuation, and stream pause preservation.
epiphy.config.client.enableVanillaMusicD: Duck Vanilla Music During Managed BGM
Gently mutes vanilla background music while managed custom music streams are playing.
epiphy.config.client.debugPerfSampling.t: Enables microsecond-resolution native render telemetry (inspect via /epiphy debug renderperf).
epiphy.config.common.enableAsyncFileLogg: Writes diagnostic and audit logs asynchronously under <gameDir>/epiphy-data/.
epiphy.config.common.logDeprecationWarni: Logs one-time migration hints when deprecated protocol field aliases are encountered.
